You are the landscape architect for the actual Terra-designed Breezeway Courtyard Villa. Stages 2–4 are accepted and immutable: 23 rooms, four bedrooms, five bathroom rooms, flat 60×48 m property, stone base, cream stucco, bronze standing-seam roofs and south veranda.
Design ONLY the outdoor composition through the required strict design-intent schema. Do not return coordinates or house changes. Software derives and validates every position, size, crown envelope, route, terrace patch and furniture placement. No one-shot building regeneration, terrain, grading or changes to walls, stairs, roofs or existing finishes.
Create a cohesive Caribbean luxury garden with integrated pool/coping, level terraces, shaded veranda dining, optional garden lounge, sun loungers, tropical planting, lawn, a welcoming drive and restrained path lighting. Use deliberate palm groupings and layered boundaries, never random scattering.
Pool scale intimate = 10×4 m; generous = 12×4.5 m; lap = 14×4 m. Its full pool/deck reservation adds 3.2 m to width and 4.4 m to depth. Align with veranda centre or measured living-room axis. Separation close = 0.6 m; promenade = 1.2 m. Software refuses any non-fitting selection. All pool decks align to the fixed house terrace's 0.3 m surface datum.
Arrival north or west chooses the property-boundary approach to the actual fixed north entrance court. Palm-avenue places paired rows by the drive; garden-court moves more palms into the garden perimeter. Palm counts six/eight/ten are exact. Medium uses roughly 6.2 m palms; varied-tall targets 7.2–8.4 m but software fits actual crown clearance and reports adjustments. Each palm remains individually editable.
Layered-tropical makes four measured boundary bands with denser botanical groupings; restrained-tropical uses three lighter bands. Garden-panels keeps four editable lawn regions; open-lawn groups the same clear ground into one editable field. Individual beds remain editable; their repeated plants are instances. Dining seats and sunbeds remain separate editable objects. Lighting is modest emissive bollard detail in daylight, not certified electrical design or night illumination.
Keep statement <=900 characters, at most six intentions <=250 characters. Retain 400 elements total; software rejects any over-budget result and preserves Stage 4. Existing house = 314 elements, capacity = 86. No hidden removal of architecture. The landscape must feel composed, not merely pass validation.
